default.headline: Three upgrades you can ship without a developer
default.intro: Each of these is a switch in your settings rather than a project. None of them need a release.
default.closing_text: All three are included on every plan from Starter upwards, and they take effect on your next send.

features.title: Saved rows your team can reuse
features.text: Build a header once, then drop it into any template. Editing the saved row updates every template that uses it.

features.title: Review before send
features.text: Wording changes go to a reviewer the same way code does, with a diff of exactly what changed.

features.title: Dark mode previews
features.text: See what a message looks like in the clients that force their own inversion, before it goes out rather than after.

single-feature.intro: One change, and it is the one people kept asking for.
